question.content:
The function $f$ is defined over the real numbers. This table gives select values of $f$.

$x$ | $5.98$ | $5.99$ | $6$ | $6.01$ | $6.02$ | $6.03$
:- | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$f(x)$| $4.19$ | $4.18$ | $0.2$ | $4.18$ | $4.19$ | $4.2$

**What is a reasonable estimate for $\displaystyle \lim_{x\to 6}f(x)$?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.clue: Not so fast! Although $f(6)=0.2$, that doesn't mean the limit has the same value. From the table values, it appears that $f$ is decreasing to the left of $x=6$ and increasing to the right, so we would expect $\displaystyle \lim_{x\to 6}f(x)$ to be slightly less than $4.18$.
